references.text: Joshua 16:10 contains the original account that Ephraim did not drive out the Canaanites living in Gezer, which Judges 1:29 refers to directly.
1 Kings 9:16 tells us that Pharaoh later captured Gezer and gave it to his daughter, Solomon's wife, showing that the Canaanites continued to live there long after Ephraim failed to drive them out.
Joshua 21:21 mentions that Gezer was given to the Levites from the tribe of Ephraim, even though the Canaanites still lived there.
This verse describes a similar pattern where Benjamin did not drive out the Jebusites from Jerusalem, illustrating the recurring theme of Israel's inability to complete the conquest of the land.
These verses describe Manasseh's corresponding failure to drive out the Canaanites from several cities, showing the same problem that Ephraim had in Gezer.
The angel of the Lord rebukes Israel for not driving out the Canaanites and explains the consequences of their disobedience as described in Judges 1:29.
